question: Can exact downstream weight geometry add the two functionally read H3 modes that variance-SVD and scalar/complement DAS miss?

motivation.rank2_actuation: The frozen cross-environment rank-two semantic union carries only 71-75% of full-H3 behavior and 66-71% of L15H5/H1 transport.
motivation.response_svd_red_team: A rank-four basis captured 87.97% of fit response energy but did not improve either held-out causal metric, identifying raw response variance as the wrong object.
motivation.user_hypothesis: Translate a shared activation subspace through actual weights to identify which components read and write it, then test that tensor-derived interface causally.

frozen_design.semantic_core: Thin-QR normalization of the already frozen v1/v2 rank-two H3 union; no refitting.
frozen_design.weight_reader_map: Map H3 head coordinates through the L11H3 output slice, then through the normalized q/k/q2/k2/v input-weight sections of L15H5 and L15H1. Stack all ten maps.
frozen_design.augmentation: Project the stacked reader map orthogonal to the semantic rank-two core, take its top two right singular vectors, and thin-QR the four-column union. This uses checkpoint tensors only: no labels, margins, examples, gradients, or fit updates.
frozen_design.sealed_test: Actuate full H3, frozen rank two, weight-derived rank four, and its exact orthogonal complement on the already capability-frozen v8 population. Measure answer/foil behavior and induced L15H5/H1 head-output response only after the basis is fixed.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_instrument_and_pr: All authorities match; bases are orthonormal within 1e-5; reconstruction/identity/projection errors and price pass frozen gates.
predictions.pred_b_weight_modes_add_static_reader_en: Rank four captures at least 10 percentage points more normalized static L15H5/H1 reader-map energy than rank two.
predictions.pred_c_weight_rank4_improves_fresh_behav: In both v8 panels rank four carries at least 85% of full-H3 behavior and improves at least 8 points over frozen rank two.
predictions.pred_d_weight_rank4_complement_is_select: The rank-four orthogonal complement carries at most 18% of full-H3 behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_weight_rank4_improves_downstream_: In both panels rank four carries at least 85% of full-H3 L15H5/H1 response and improves at least 8 points over frozen rank two.

decision: Identification requires A-E. If B passes but causal predictions C-E do not, static tensor incidence is an incomplete functional metric (activation-conditioned routing/intervening nonlinearities are required). If B fails, invalidate the construction rather than interpreting behavior.
